rachel_se: Quick sync: Nimbus Financial wants a POC but their procurement insists on region-locking to eu-central-1 and a list of subprocessors limited to our internal stack (no external analytics). They asked whether Hosted pinned tenants can have subprocessor restrictions.

diego_infra: We support tenant-level routing to any available region (eu-central-1 included) for hosted. Subprocessor restrictions are possible for telemetry by switching to internal-only telemetry for that tenant as a config flag. However some platform-level subprocessors (cloud provider, infra monitoring) cannot be removed.

sami_legal: We need to confirm which subprocessors are considered "platform-level" vs "optional" and draft an SQ response matrix. Also note: region-locking that prevents failover requires a DPA addendum and a signing of a Residual Risk form.

evan_pricing: Pricing note: region lock surcharge varies by region. eu-central-1 is 10% surcharge on host charges for egress and reserved ops time. BYOK onboarding fee applies if they request our validation. I can produce a sandbox quote if we get their expected token volumes.

rachel_se: They also want to know if cross-region backups are created automatically. Does hosted create backups in multiple regions?

diego_infra: backup policy: snapshot backups of model cache and logs are stored in primary region by default; metadata replicated to control plane. For strict-residency we can restrict backups to eu-central-1 but that's an exception requiring ops/infra signoff. That would increase RTO risk.

opsbot: Request logged: TKT-55821 region-lock-request. Assigned to diego_infra and ops-eng. ETA: sandbox pin in 48h after signed waiver & PO.

rachel_se: I'll ask for expected traffic, their list of banned subprocessors, and whether they want backups restricted. Also ask if they will accept a canary failover window.

sami_legal: I'll prep template language for DPA addendum and residual risk waiver. Also loop in compliance for the SQ answers.

evan_pricing: I'll prepare three pricing lines: hosted+pin, hosted+pin+backup-restriction, and dedicated baseline. Send me volumes and I will calc estimates.

rachel_se: thanks all. will update when Nimbus responds. :email:
